summary: Induction on j; at each step the new floor's Weyl ratio rescales the variable of the Weyl law.

steps.lean:
j.rec (by simp [weylRatio]) fun j ih hj _ ↦ by
  rw [Finset.prod_range_succ_comm, mul_assoc, ← ih, upperMeasure, (by lia : _ - 0 =
    j + (𝔰.ϱ - j + 2)), descConv_add, descConv_floorMeasure_succ, mconv_assoc, mconv_assoc]
  repeat rw [lintegral_mconv, lintegral_map, lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul]
  rw [lintegral_eq_mul_lintegral_map (map_mul_volume (p j / q j)), lintegral_map,
    ← lintegral_const_mul, ← lintegral_const_mul, lintegral_congr_of_ae_imp ae_isUnit]
  all_goals first | fun_prop | lia | simp [mul_pow, ← mul_assoc]
  congr! 5; grind [=_ pow_succ']; ext
  simp [coe_weylRatio, floorWeyl, weylOn, division_def, Ring.mul_inverse_rev]
  grind [Units.inv_mul, =_ star_mul, oppositeIndex_spec]

steps.claim: j = 0: weylRatio(0, p, q) = 1 and the product is empty.

steps.lean:
fun j ih hj _ ↦ by
  rw [Finset.prod_range_succ_comm, mul_assoc, ← ih, upperMeasure, (by lia : _ - 0 =
    j + (𝔰.ϱ - j + 2)), descConv_add, descConv_floorMeasure_succ, mconv_assoc, mconv_assoc]
  repeat rw [lintegral_mconv, lintegral_map, lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul]
  rw [lintegral_eq_mul_lintegral_map (map_mul_volume (p j / q j)), lintegral_map,
    ← lintegral_const_mul, ← lintegral_const_mul, lintegral_congr_of_ae_imp ae_isUnit]
  all_goals first | fun_prop | lia | simp [mul_pow, ← mul_assoc]
  congr! 5; grind [=_ pow_succ']; ext
  simp [coe_weylRatio, floorWeyl, weylOn, division_def, Ring.mul_inverse_rev]
  grind [Units.inv_mul, =_ star_mul, oppositeIndex_spec]
steps.claim: From j to j + 1 (ih: the claim for j; j + 1 ≤ ϱ).

steps.lean:
rw [Finset.prod_range_succ_comm, mul_assoc, ← ih, upperMeasure, (by lia : _ - 0 =
    j + (𝔰.ϱ - j + 2)), descConv_add, descConv_floorMeasure_succ, mconv_assoc, mconv_assoc]
steps.claim: Take the factor a = j out of the product and use ih; write θ = upperMeasure(F, 0) as (θ^F_{ϱ+1} ∗ ⋯ ∗ θ^F_j) ∗ (θ^F_{j−1} ∗ ⋯ ∗ θ^F_0) and then θ^F_{ϱ+1} ∗ ⋯ ∗ θ^F_j = (weylLaw(j) ∗ (θ^F_{ϱ+1} ∗ ⋯ ∗ θ^F_{j+1})) ∗ η_j (j < ϱ); reassociate.
Expand the integrals over the convolutions and over the Weyl law (density md(c)^{d_j}, d_j = k + 1 + 2(ϱ − j − 1)).

steps.lean:
rw [lintegral_eq_mul_lintegral_map (map_mul_volume (p j / q j)), lintegral_map,
    ← lintegral_const_mul, ← lintegral_const_mul, lintegral_congr_of_ae_imp ae_isUnit]
  all_goals first | fun_prop | lia | simp [mul_pow, ← mul_assoc]
steps.claim: Substitute c ↦ (p_j/q_j)·c in the integral over A (its image measure is md(p_j/q_j)⁻¹dc) and restrict to units; the measurability and arithmetic side goals close.

steps.lean:
congr! 5; grind [=_ pow_succ']; ext
  simp [coe_weylRatio, floorWeyl, weylOn, division_def, Ring.mul_inverse_rev]
  grind [Units.inv_mul, =_ star_mul, oppositeIndex_spec]
steps.claim: The exponents match (d_j + 1 = k + 2(ϱ − j)), and the matrices match: the floor-j part of weylRatio(j+1, p, q) = diag(p_j/q_j at e_j, (q_j/p_j)* at e*_j) times w_j(c)⁻¹ equals w_j(c')⁻¹ with the rescaled c', and the remaining part is weylRatio(j, p, q), entrywise from coe_weylRatio.
